body:
Founder real-time: how can we make slow league more intelligent through adversarial learning, critic+bot co-learn -> that needs to be super slow league -> where bots are always only vs humans. Named this as GAIL (real, established technique), connected directly to the CAPTCHA doc's own unsolved humanness-signal gap. Scoped Super Slow League as a real new matchmaker constraint (always exactly 1 bot per match, never bot-vs-bot) so the discriminator gets clean paired human/bot trajectory data from the same match context -- the real reason ordinary bot-fill queue padding wouldn't work. Named the real current gap (no human trajectory logging exists in SHANKPIT yet) and the real adversarial-training instability risk. 4-phase plan. New open question #4 added. No code shipped. NORTHSTAR.md, commit c12d811 (local repo, no remote yet).

⚓ ☃
title: Scoped: GAIL adversarial discriminator + 'Super Slow League' matchmaker constraint
